jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT TRAVERSAL 

Traversal https://www.traversal.com/ is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) for the enterprise—already trusted by some of the largest companies in the world to troubleshoot, remediate, and even prevent the most complex production incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and enable them to focus on creative, high-impact work. 

Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we’re channeling that scientific rigor and creativity into building the premier AI agent lab for the enterprise. Hence, what we’re proudest of is assembling the most talented yet nicest group of individuals, including researchers from MIT, Harvard, and Berkeley, to world-class engineers from industry: Citadel Securities, Cockroach Labs, Datadog, DE Shaw, ServiceNow, Glean, Perplexity, Pinecone, and more, to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Without the entire team, none of this would be possible.


THE ROLE

In this role, you’ll define how we tell Traversal’s story, shape our positioning, and drive go-to-market execution as we bring our agentic observability platform out of stealth. This is a rare opportunity to join during a foundational stage of growth, where you’ll have an outsized impact on how customers experience and understand Traversal.

You’ll work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales teams to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with SREs, platform teams, and engineering leaders. You’ll work closely with our CEO and BizOps lead to translate learnings from founder-led sales into a repeatable playbook as we build out our sales function. You’ll create technical marketing content, drive customer and competitive research, and build early sales enablement programs to support our market expansion. If you thrive in high-ownership, high-velocity environments—and are excited to help define how AI-native infrastructure products come to market—we’d love to meet you.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and execute Traversal’s product marketing strategy across positioning, messaging, content, and product launches.

 - Translate complex technical concepts into clear narratives that connect to real-world customer pain points.

 - Develop technical marketing content, including website copy, case studies, technical blogs, videos and product collateral.

 - Support community-building initiatives through events, content, and partnerships that engage SREs, platform teams, and the broader AI infrastructure ecosystem.

 - Conduct market research, customer discovery, and competitive analysis to inform product and marketing strategy.

 - Partner with product management and engineering to shape roadmap decisions based on market and user insights.

 - Build early sales enablement programs and materials to help our team tell the Traversal story effectively.

 - Act as a cross-functional connector between product, engineering, sales, and marketing.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 7+ years in product marketing or a hybrid product/technical marketing role, ideally in AI, observability, infrastructure, or developer tools.

 - Strong ability to dive deep into technical products and communicate them effectively to both technical and business audiences.

 - Experience working closely with product and engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Passion for AI innovation and a desire to help define how AI-native infrastructure products go to market.

 - Proven ability to build foundational marketing programs from scratch and evolve them over time.

 - Familiarity with AI or LLM-powered products.


COMPENSATION

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and additional benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this full-time, in-person role in New York is $150,000 - $300,000 plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on location, level, and role. Individual compensation is determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.




WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US

We’ll make sure you’re fully supported with health insurance, a great tech setup, flexible time off, and plenty of in-office snacks. We offer competitive salary and equity packages, and take thoughtful consideration with every hire on our small, high-impact team.

Traversal is fully in-office, 5 days a week, based in New York near Madison Square Park. We have a collaborative, hard-working culture and are energized by building the future of AI-powered software maintenance.

Working here means owning meaningful parts of the product, having the flexibility to move fast, and learning constantly. This is a place to grow your career, make a real impact, and help define a new category of infrastructure software.
